en-US.description: Power of appbase.io via CLI, with nifty imports from your favorite data sources
en-US.longDescription: ABC is a command-line tool to interact with appbase.io. It can also serve as a swiss army knife to import data from any popular data source (Postgres, SQL, Mongo) to ElasticSearch. This feature works with minimum configuration and is totally automatic. In certain sources like Postgres and Mongo, you can even keep the database and ElasticSearch cluster in sync such that any change from source gets added in destination as well.
en-US.name: ABC

zh-CN.description: 通过命令行使用 appbase.io 的强大功能，并从您最喜爱的数据源进行快捷导入
zh-CN.longDescription: ABC 是与 appbase.io 交互的命令行工具，还是将数据从任何流行的数据源（Postgres、SQL、Mongo）导入到 ElasticSearch 的瑞士军刀。只需最少配置即可完全自动运行。在某些数据源（如 Postgres 和 Mongo）中，您甚至可以让数据库和 ElasticSearch 集群保持同步，这样源数据中的任何变动都会被应用到目标数据中。
